name: Restrict Payment & POS Features
description: Take full control of your Point of Sale system in Odoo with the POS Payment Restriction & Order Control Module. This powerful extension allows administrators to restrict payment processing, disable order line modifications, prevent unauthorized discounts, and block price changes—ensuring secure and consistent cashier operations.
summary:
The pos_disable_payments module for Odoo provides a robust solution for businesses looking to enhance Point of Sale (POS) security and improve staff control. This module allows administrators to restrict or completely disable specific POS features such as payments, discounts, price and quantity edits, order line deletions, and customer selection. Permissions are highly customizable, enabling control on a per-user or per-employee basis.
With this module, businesses can ensure that sensitive POS functions are only accessible by authorized personnel, reducing the risk of errors, fraud, or unauthorized actions. Features like disabling the numpad and +/- buttons, along with blocking changes to prices and discounts, prevent accidental or malicious alterations.
Ideal for retail stores, restaurants, and any business with multiple cashiers or sensitive POS operations, the pos_disable_payments module enhances accountability by providing a clear audit trail for user actions. name: POS Out of Stock Alert
description: The POS Out of Stock Alert module notifies cashiers when a product is out of stock, helping prevent overselling and improving inventory awareness. Unlike restrictive modules, it does not block sales - instead, it provides a clear warning so users can make informed decisions during checkout.
summary: Enhance your Odoo POS system with POS Out of Stock Alert, a simple yet powerful tool that notifies cashiers when products are out of stock. The module improves stock visibility, reduces overselling errors, and ensures real-time synchronization with backend inventory. With clear alerts for unavailable products, your POS team can make informed decisions without blocking sales, maintaining smooth retail operations and customer satisfaction. This module seamlessly integrates with your existing POS interface, providing instant, on-screen warnings for out-of-stock items. It helps cashiers manage orders more efficiently, prevents inventory mistakes, and ensures transparency across all sales channels. By providing real-time information at the point of sale, businesses can enhance operational accuracy, minimize refund scenarios, and improve customer trust. Lightweight and easy to configure, POS Out of Stock Alert is the perfect solution for retailers seeking better inventory awareness and smoother checkout processes. summary: POS Transaction Fee lets you easily configure and apply extra charges in Odoo Point of Sale. The fee is automatically applied at checkout, clearly shown on the POS screen and customer receipt, and recorded in the backend and accounting for accurate reporting. POS Transaction Fee is a powerful Odoo module that enables businesses to automatically apply transaction charges during Point of Sale operations. Whether you want to recover payment gateway costs, bank charges, or service fees, this module helps you configure charges as either fixed amounts (e.g., $2 per order) or percentage-based (e.g., 2% of the order total). The module is highly flexible - you can apply fees to specific payment methods (like credit cards or mobile wallets) while excluding others (like cash). This ensures accurate, real-world handling of different payment scenarios. Once configured, the fee is automatically calculated and displayed on the POS payment screen, allowing cashiers and customers to see the breakdown before confirming the order. After validation, the fee is included in the customer receipt (printed or emailed), ensuring transparency at every step. name: POS Birthday Discount
description: This will auto Apply discount to the customer cart when its their birthday.
summary:
The Birthday Discount in POS module is designed to enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty by providing special discounts automatically on customer birthdays. It integrates seamlessly with the Odoo Point of Sale system, ensuring that birthday-based promotions are applied smoothly without extra effort from cashiers. The module begins by allowing you to store and configure customer birthdates within their contact details. Once set, you can configure the rules for the birthday discount whether it should be a fixed percentage, a specific amount, or applied only under certain conditions. This flexibility gives businesses control over how generous or restrictive they want to be with the birthday reward system. The discount itself is applied automatically to the customer order. Cashiers don’t have to remember or manually select discounts, which reduces mistakes and speeds up transactions. The system ensures that only eligible customers (those with birthdays) receive the discount, making the process efficient and reliable. name: POS User Signature
description: The POS Signature module enhances Odoo Point of Sale by allowing cashiers or customers to draw and save digital signatures directly from the POS interface.
summary: The POS Signature module for Odoo 18 enhances your Point of Sale workflow by introducing secure and convenient digital signature capture. It eliminates the need for paper-based confirmations and improves accountability across your sales and service processes. Designed for retailers, restaurants, and service providers, this app ensures that every transaction can be validated with a legally binding digital signature. Once installed, the module integrates seamlessly into Odoo’s POS system without requiring complicated setup. Administrators can configure signature options under Point of Sale - Settings, where toggles allow you to enable User Signature, Signature with Name, and Signature Display on Receipts. These flexible settings allow you to tailor the feature to your operational needs, whether you want signatures for every transaction or only for specific cases. During a transaction, cashiers can quickly access the Add Signature button in the POS interface. A smooth, user-friendly signature pad pops up, enabling customers or users to draw their signature and enter their name directly on the screen. This interactive step adds a professional touch to your checkout process while ensuring that all approvals are properly documented.
